thread:
sam-cs: Heads-up: AegisHealth (dedicated) seeing rising p95 on inference endpoint during morning batch window. Overall errors fine but customers report slower UI refresh.

rachel-ops: Any config changes or traffic pattern shifts?

sam-cs: They started sending longer context for case summaries (avg tokens ~700) and moved to bursty submit pattern around 09:00 PST.

lee-ml: Given long contexts, two ideas: 1) route short requests (<512 tokens) to a compact-int8 model; 2) enable per-customer prefix caching for repeated case headers; 3) enable KV warmup on scale events.

priya-se: Love that. We need a short checklist before canary: data retention check, top-10 prompt regression eval, and an emergency rollback trigger (automatic if p95 increases >10% vs baseline).

lee-ml: Proposed minimal routing rule: if tokens <=512 -> model=compact-a1@int8; else -> model=base-b2@fp16. Canary plan: 8h window, 15% of traffic that meets short-query predicate.

sam-cs: I'll share this plan with Aegis PM. They care about hallucination on discharge notes, so we must include a semantic similarity check with thresholds.

priya-se: Quick canary API payload I can run once PM thumbs-up:

```
POST /v1/accounts/aegishealth/canary
{
  "route_predicate": "tokens <= 512",
  "fraction": 0.15,
  "model": "compact-a1",
  "quant": "int8",
  "rollback_if": "p95 > baseline * 1.10 or hallucination_rate > 0.015"
}
```

deploy-bot: Canary created: #canary-5981 scheduled in 25m.

rachel-ops: I'll prewarm caches and add a temporary prefix cache TTL=5m for common patient headers. Monitoring: p50/p95, error rate, top-intent F1, and cost delta.

sam-cs: Noting in renewal tracker as "proactive perf optimization offered". Will request PM sign and post results in this thread.

lee-ml: I'll produce a short eval dashboard comparing compact-a1 vs base-b2 on top-20 intents. If regressions <2% and latency improves ~30%, recommend broad swap for short queries.

sam-cs: Thanks team. Follow-ups: PM approval, run canary, collect evals, decide roll. /end
